Astryx CLI
Commands, programmatic APIs, and output contracts. Building an integration is under `npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs
authoring`.

package: @astryxdesign/cli

Use the CLI in any folder: install it once for your computer, and every project still gets the release that matches its Core. See `npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs global`.

Guides

component-lookups              Look up one or several exact component identities, choose a focused projection, and
                               handle complete batch receipts.
host-entry                     Run the Astryx CLI from your own command-line tool: the inputs `runHostedCli` takes, what
                               it returns, and when the process ends instead.
experimental                   [experimental] Features you can try now that may change or be removed in a patch release.
experimental/icon-sets         [experimental] Ship an icon set: register each icon against an icon definition, so apps
                               find icons by meaning and templates use your icons.
experimental/icon-set-files    [experimental] Every field of the files an icon set is made of: the descriptor, the data
                               file, and an icon definition.
experimental/icon-definitions  [experimental] Every icon definition: what an icon stands for, and the shared name icon
                               sets map their icons to. (145 docs below)
experimental/render-pages      Experimental. Render a page to one self-contained HTML file for sharing or embedding, and
                               get the page back from it.

Reference

commands                          Every command and subcommand: usage, options, examples, exit codes, and what it does
                                  outside a project.
commands/blog                     astryx blog: Read the Astryx blog from the published feed
commands/build                    astryx build: Build a page: the template to start from, or the workflow playbook (no
                                  query)
commands/component                astryx component: List components or print component docs
commands/discover                 astryx discover: Browse and search integrations: the ones you have and the ones you
                                  could add
commands/docs                     astryx docs: Print reference docs
commands/doctor                   astryx doctor: Diagnose Astryx projects and integration packages
commands/doctor-integration       astryx doctor integration: Check an integration package while authoring it
commands/doctor-integration-components  astryx doctor integration components: Check integration component names,
                                  replacements, and documented props
commands/doctor-integration-docs  astryx doctor integration docs: Check an integration's docs: the docs tree they add,
                                  every link, and overlaps with Core topics
commands/doctor-integration-templates  astryx doctor integration templates: Validate integration template replacements
                                  and Core id overlaps
commands/doctor-integration-validate  astryx doctor integration validate: Validate an integration manifest and its
                                  contributions
commands/experimental             [experimental] astryx experimental: Try features that may change in a patch release:
                                  icon sets (find icons, build an icon-set package)
commands/experimental-icon        [experimental] astryx experimental icon: Find an icon by meaning, or build an icon set
                                  from a library (guide: astryx docs cli/experimental/icon-sets)
commands/experimental-icon-add    [experimental] astryx experimental icon add: Register one icon you chose from a
                                  library in your icon set
commands/experimental-icon-map    [experimental] astryx experimental icon map: Register which icon of your set draws an
                                  icon definition
commands/experimental-icon-new-definition  [experimental] astryx experimental icon new-definition: Add your icon set's
                                  own icon definition
commands/experimental-icon-new-set  [experimental] astryx experimental icon new-set: Start an icon set in your
                                  integration package
commands/experimental-icon-use    [experimental] astryx experimental icon use: Choose the project's icon set
commands/experimental-render      [experimental] astryx experimental render: Render a page to one self-contained HTML
                                  file, or turn one back into a page
commands/gap-report               astryx gap-report: Report a missing component or feature to the package that owns it
commands/hook                     astryx hook: List hooks or print hook docs
commands/init                     astryx init: Initialize the design system in your project
commands/integration              astryx integration: Author and verify an Astryx integration package
commands/integration-add          astryx integration add: Add one working contribution to an integration package
commands/integration-check        astryx integration check: The CI check for an integration package's own build: every
                                  source check, run in continuous integration or a typecheck script, against the package
                                  in the current folder
commands/integration-pack         astryx integration pack: Deprecated: the old name of `integration verify`
commands/integration-verify       astryx integration verify: Check the package the way npm will publish it, before you
                                  publish
commands/manifest                 astryx manifest: Print the full CLI capability manifest (use with --json)
commands/postinstall              astryx postinstall: Print the welcome message shown after install
commands/search                   astryx search: Search components, hooks, docs, templates, and themes in one ranked
                                  list
commands/swizzle                  astryx swizzle: Copy component source for customization
commands/template                 astryx template: List, show, or scaffold page and block templates
commands/theme                    astryx theme: Add, switch, build, and author themes
commands/theme-add                astryx theme add: Add a built theme to the app. To copy a theme's source as an
                                  editable fork, run `theme eject <slug> [path] [--overwrite]`.
commands/theme-build              astryx theme build: Compile standalone themes or one keyed theme family
commands/theme-eject              astryx theme eject: Fork a theme as editable local source
commands/theme-list               astryx theme list: List themes available to add
commands/theme-palette            astryx theme palette: Create and work with theme-owned color palettes
commands/theme-palette-generate   astryx theme palette generate: Generate an OKLCH palette candidate for human review
commands/theme-remove             astryx theme remove: Remove a non-default theme from the app
commands/theme-targets            astryx theme targets: List the component theming targets a theme can override
commands/theme-template           astryx theme template: Write the annotated theme template into your project
commands/theme-use                astryx theme use: Choose the app default from its added themes
commands/upgrade                  astryx upgrade: Update your code after upgrading Astryx, and refresh ShadCN-copied
                                  components
api                               The programmatic API: functions, the JSON output envelope, error codes, and response
                                  types.
api/functions                     Every function: its signature, parameters, returns, and errors. (52 docs below)
api/schemas                       Data shapes, field by field. (1 doc below)
api/enums                         Every fixed list of values, such as error codes and response types. (2 docs below)

Open one: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs cli/<name>
Up: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs
